scope: Preserve every generation-6 exact user unit (43/43) and add the current user's 2026-09-16 epistemological correction directed at audit report 09 section 5: theory is always an abstraction of reality, always a kind of analogy, an imitation that tries to extract reality's core skeleton; even a mathematical object absent from reality is a skeletal imitation of an imagined reality, so there is no such thing as a theory whose reality side cannot be grasped. Mathematics and HoTT necessarily map onto reality — one can explain a homotopy type in plain words with real examples — and it is precisely while interpreting theory with reality and aligning the two that one locates the premises a theory sacrificed for economy but should not have. AI is not unable to think reality, its training data is full of reality; what is missing is the attempt to understand theory by way of reality, as the user did for Russell, Better-Best and the Shenchen paradox, and as the original motivation of machine overview itself already was (whether one can build a non-halting program in HoTT is a reality question). Recorded as three semantic units.
